metaDescription: Order custom 50 oz bar wine for events and promotions. Perfect for bulk gifts. Get a quote from Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: When you need barware that stands out in both size and branding, 50 oz bar wine vessels deliver. These oversized options are ideal for corporate events, tailgates, or promotional giveaways where a standard 12 oz glass just won't cut it. Whether you choose a durable acrylic tumbler or an insulated stainless steel option, the generous capacity ensures guests stay refreshed without constant refills. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or etching for a memorable impression that lasts long after the event.
heroAltText: Custom 50 oz bar wine tumblers with corporate logo, perfect for large events and promotional giveaways.
